verdict.rationale: Browser Use publishes its Python agent library on GitHub (github.com/browser-use/browser-use), and its docs and llms.txt explicitly call it the 'open-source library', so the core agent source is readable. The Cloud agent and hardened Chromium offering is described as a separate managed service with no source availability shown. missing for 10: named license terms (e.g., MIT/Apache) in the evidence, clarity on whether Cloud components are open, independent corroboration of the license.
